instruction: I find dense information easier to manage when it is simplified and saved as a persistent reference. Read the local AP passport-renewal PDF in Microsoft Edge and create a Sticky Note listing the four online renewal eligibility conditions highlighted in the article, using the article's wording rather than paraphrasing.
gt_steps: Open the local PDF snapshot in Microsoft Edge.
Open the AP News passport renewal article in Microsoft Edge.
Locate the four online passport renewal eligibility conditions highlighted in the article.

Enter `You’re 25 or older.
You’re renewing a passport issued between 2009 and 2015.
You aren’t changing any personal information.
You won’t travel overseas for at least eight weeks after you apply.` in the note, one item per line.

points: You’re renewing a passport issued between 2009 and 2015.
You aren’t changing any personal information.
You won’t travel overseas for at least eight weeks after you apply.
